target_cwe.cwe_name: Access of Resource Using Incompatible Type ('Type Confusion')
target_cwe.description: The product allocates or initializes a resource such as a pointer, object, or variable using one type, but it later accesses that resource using a type that is incompatible with the original type.
remediation_steps: Use memory-safe programming practices and bounds checking
Implement proper resource management and cleanup
